---
name: documentation-update
description: Keep README, technical docs, ADRs and diagrams aligned with a meaningful change.
---


1. Identify changed behavior, commands, API contracts, architecture and operational assumptions.
2. Update affected existing documents; avoid a new documentation structure for each feature.
3. Use a new/superseding ADR only for a durable architecture decision.
4. Keep editable Draw.io sources and appropriate exports aligned if diagrams are affected.
5. Check links, command examples and the accuracy of test claims. Never copy tokens or raw sensitive logs.
6. Report updated paths, or explain a legitimate no-content-change outcome.
